jenson-roman-typeface.research_focus: 1470s Venetian print shops, hand-cut steel punches and cast metal type with round, even letterforms
jenson-roman-typeface.scene: A Venetian printer in a long robe lifting a freshly inked page from a wooden hand press, a tray of cast metal letters and a steel punch with a small raised letter on the bench beside him

caxton-westminster-press.research_focus: 1470s Westminster print shop, a wooden screw press and a merchant-turned-printer in late medieval dress
caxton-westminster-press.scene: A merchant in a fur-trimmed gown standing at a wooden screw press in a stone-vaulted workshop, a journeyman inking a form of type while finished sheets hang to dry on cords

garamond-roman-type.research_focus: 1530s Paris punchcutters' workshops, steel punches, matrices and the tools of letter-cutting
garamond-roman-type.scene: A Parisian punchcutter in a leather apron bent over a bench with a magnifying glass, filing a tiny letter into the end of a steel punch, rows of finished punches and brass matrices laid out beside him

bay-psalm-book.research_focus: 1640 Cambridge, Massachusetts, Puritan dress, a small colonial press in a timber house
bay-psalm-book.scene: A Puritan printer in a plain dark coat and white collar pulling the bar of a small wooden press inside a rough timber house, a stack of freshly printed sheets and a window onto a frozen colonial street behind him

caslon-type-specimen.research_focus: 1730s London type foundry, an engraver's workshop with punches, moulds and cast type in many sizes
caslon-type-specimen.scene: A London engraver in a wig and shirtsleeves holding up a large sheet pinned with rows of type in graduated sizes, a type mould and a tray of cast metal letters on the workbench in front of him

baskerville-virgil.research_focus: 1750s Birmingham, John Baskerville's press, glossy hot-pressed paper and a handsome quarto book
baskerville-virgil.scene: A well-dressed Birmingham printer in a silk coat turning the pages of a large newly printed quarto book on a polished table, a wooden press and a stack of smooth paper behind him in a bright workshop

first-sans-serif-typeface.research_focus: early 1800s London type foundry, large display capitals cast for posters and shop signs
first-sans-serif-typeface.scene: A Regency-era type founder holding a block of heavy, plain, thick-stroked capital letters cast in metal up to the light, a poster board and trays of ornamented serif letters of older design lying discarded on the bench

sholes-typewriter-patent.research_focus: 1860s Milwaukee machine shop, the first Sholes and Glidden typewriter prototypes and period workshop dress
sholes-typewriter-patent.scene: A bearded inventor in a waistcoat sitting at a bulky wooden-framed prototype typewriter with a piano-like row of round keys and a ring of metal typebars, a sheet of paper in the carriage and a machinist's bench behind him

remington-typewriter-sales.research_focus: 1870s Remington factory in Ilion, New York, the Sholes and Glidden typewriter with its decorative floral enamel and treadle
remington-typewriter-sales.scene: A Victorian typewriter on a sewing-machine-style treadle stand with floral decoration on its black metal frame, standing in a showroom, a salesman in a frock coat demonstrating it to a curious clerk

johnston-london-typeface.research_focus: 1910s London Underground stations, enamel signs, posters and Edward Johnston's calligraphy studio
johnston-london-typeface.scene: A calligrapher with a broad-edged pen at a sloping desk drawing large, evenly spaced letters on paper in a quiet studio, beside a London Underground platform sign-board in the same lettering with a roundel above it

futura-typeface-released.research_focus: 1920s German Bauhaus era, geometric design, drawing compasses and set squares, Frankfurt type foundry
futura-typeface-released.scene: A drawing board in a modernist German studio with a compass, a set square and a ruler laid on a sheet showing a letter built from a perfect circle and straight lines, a tall window and a bare modern chair behind

times-new-roman-debut.research_focus: 1930s London newspaper composing room, Linotype machines, tightly set narrow columns of newsprint
times-new-roman-debut.scene: A 1930s London newspaper composing room, a compositor in an apron lifting a page of tightly packed columns of metal type into a steel frame, a Linotype machine and a stack of folded newspapers behind him

helvetica-released.research_focus: 1950s Swiss graphic design, Haas type foundry in Münchenstein, International Style signs and posters
helvetica-released.scene: A Swiss designer in a white shirt and narrow tie laying out large plain sans-serif letters cut from card on a clean studio table, a modernist poster grid and a grid of railway station signs on the wall

ibm-selectric-typewriter.research_focus: 1960s American offices, the IBM Selectric with its rotating type ball and curved sculpted housing
ibm-selectric-typewriter.scene: A secretary in a 1960s office lifting a small golf-ball-shaped metal type element, covered in raised letters, out of a sleek sculpted electric typewriter, a second type ball in her other hand and a tray of papers beside the machine

project-gutenberg-begins.research_focus: 1971 university mainframe computer lab, teletype terminals and punched paper, Illinois campus
project-gutenberg-begins.scene: A teletype terminal and a mainframe computer cabinet with reels of tape in a 1970s university computer room, a pile of continuous printout paper spilling from the printer onto the floor; no people

desktop-publishing-arrives.research_focus: mid-1980s offices, the first Macintosh with its small screen, a LaserWriter printer and page layout software
desktop-publishing-arrives.scene: A small beige all-in-one computer with a tiny screen showing a page layout of columns and pictures, a keyboard and mouse, and a bulky laser printer beside it delivering a finished page, on an ordinary office desk with a coffee cup; no people

comic-sans-created.research_focus: mid-1990s computer interface, comic book lettering by hand, a cartoon dog help assistant on screen
comic-sans-created.scene: A 1990s beige desktop computer whose screen shows a cartoon dog with a speech balloon, beside a spread of hand-lettered comic book pages and a lettering pen on the desk; no people

emoji-added-to-unicode.research_focus: 2010s smartphones, Japanese mobile phone culture, the first emoji pictograms and keyboards
emoji-added-to-unicode.scene: A hand holding a smartphone whose screen shows a grid of small smiling faces, hearts, a sun, a cat and a cherry blossom, in a busy Tokyo street with train signs and lanterns softly blurred behind
